llm_notes: Use only channels present in this JSON.
Do not infer seizure concordance from HFO data alone.
Prioritize FRandR and repeated cross-run evidence when discussing salient channels.
State uncertainty when dominant channels differ across runs.

limitations: Channel evidence is a model-saliency proxy, not direct electrophysiological onset annotation.
Scores depend on the trained seizure classifier and current preprocessing/windowing choices.
Channels labeled PAD are model padding positions and are excluded from interpretation.
